environment_details.style_notes: STYLE_ANIMATED_FEATURE_V3; toy-like geometric beauty; shells have a translucent, glass-like quality with soft specular highlights; avoids aggressive sharp edges despite the silica nature; tactile and jewel-like.

visual_logic.composition: An underwater focus shot where the diatoms appear as intricate, floating 'jewels' in the water column. The background features the soft, white chalky seafloor of the Muwaqqar formation.
visual_logic.ground: Smooth, white phosphatic limestone and fine chalk dust, providing a clean, high-albedo backdrop.
visual_logic.lighting: SUNNY_EXPOSED_CINEMATIC; light refracts through the translucent bodies of the diatoms, creating tiny caustic patterns on the seabed below.
